flag_definitions.entry_first_positive: Gate 6B.2 ENTRY_FIRST average R is greater than zero
flag_definitions.all_scenarios_positive: average R is greater than zero under EXCLUDED, ENTRY_FIRST, and ADVERSE_MOVE_FIRST
flag_definitions.all_scenarios_pf_above_1: Profit Factor is greater than one under all three chronology scenarios
flag_definitions.high_chronology_sensitivity: maximum minus minimum scenario average R is at least 0.15R
flag_definitions.low_sample_warning: overall executed trades are below 200 or any OR-width quintile carries LOW_SAMPLE
flag_definitions.boundary_target: target_points equals the upper tested boundary of 100 points
flag_definitions.width_dependence_warning: OR-width average-R range is at least 0.50R, no more than three quintiles are positive, the top two positive quintiles contribute at least 70% of positive total R, or a quintile carries LOW_SAMPLE

neighbor_rules.supporting_neighbor: all scenarios positive, all scenario PF values above 1, and ENTRY_FIRST Avg R within 0.15R of the evaluated cell
neighbor_rules.STRONG: evaluated cell is chronology-robust and has at least one supporting target neighbor and one supporting stop peer
neighbor_rules.MODERATE: evaluated cell is chronology-robust and has supporting evidence in either target or stop neighbors

proposed_core_candidates.validation_question: Does the 15m fixed-50/75-point hypothesis retain positive expectancy without the DEVELOPMENT widest-OR weakness becoming dominant?
Does the 20m midpoint/75-point hypothesis preserve its low-ambiguity, low-chronology-sensitivity profile?
Does the 30m fixed-40/75-point hypothesis persist despite its U-shaped DEVELOPMENT OR-width behavior?

Does the boundary-target and narrow-OR weakness persist outside DEVELOPMENT?
